title: The Hidden Downsides of Using AI for Dating
summary: Thinking about using AI for dating? Here are the real downsides for your mental health, and why therapy beats letting ChatGPT handle your love life.
body_markdown:
## AI-Written Dating App Messages


Creating a solid profile is just the first step to using a dating app. Getting and communicating with matches is the real experience. If you’re more shy or aren’t a fan of having conversations with new people over text, especially in a romantic way, it’s understandable that you’d want some assistance in having these conversations on a dating app. In the past, many people would consult their friends or family for ideas on how to send a good message on a dating app. This isn’t necessarily a bad idea. Tapping the people who know you best can sometimes jumpstart your ideas and help you get into the flow of a conversation with a potential partner.


But if you choose to use an AI model to write your dating app messages instead, you’re very unlikely to get the same results. An AI model can’t possibly learn every facet of your personality, so it obviously can’t replicate your own unique voice and perspective. As a single person who has been using dating apps for years, if I noticed that someone was using a tool like ChatGPT to write their responses to me while messaging on a dating app, I would unmatch them. Not only does it signal that it’s not really you sending those messages, but it also tells the other person that you thought they weren’t worth the time and effort it might take to come up with thoughtful, meaningful responses yourself. Leaning on AI to do the talking can also leave you feeling more disconnected, not less, when the whole point of dating is to build a real connection.
